summary: Round-1 MINOR src/advice/golden.ts:echo-throws-on-object-toString is fixed: echo() now converts only strings and numbers with String() and labels every other value by kind (<array>, <null>, <object>, <boolean>) before the 20-char truncation, so an own toString key can no longer throw and large arrays/objects are never stringified. New test 'echoes non-text values by kind instead of converting them' (tests/golden/golden-spots.test.ts) asserts parseGoldenSpots throws GoldenSpotValidationError for {toString:0} and checks each kind's echo text. All untrusted values interpolated into error messages still go through echo() (step, position, situation, action, alternative) or the length-capped id. The other round-1 changes are data-only (preflop-spots.json spot replacements) and add no new paths. No new dependencies. No BLOCKER, MAJOR or MINOR findings.
